dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: The main panel where you see the status of your finances and access key features.

topics.title: Quick Actions
topics.content:
From the Dashboard, you have access to quick actions to:

- Add transaction: Allows adding income or expenses to the account balance. They must be categorized.

- Create category: Allows creating new categories to organize your transactions. A budget can be assigned to them.

- Import data: Allows importing user data from a previous version to the current one.

- Export data: Allows exporting data for later import.

topics.title: Core Metrics
topics.content:
In the section immediately below, you will find four cards showing your current balance, income, expenses, and free balance. Each one shows the trend compared to the previous period with a percentage in green or red.

Use the period selector (week, month, year) to change the time range.

topics.title: Information Panels
topics.content:
Under the core metrics, you will find panels with charts and summary information about your expenses and budgets.

- Expense history: Shows a bar chart reflecting the evolution of your expenses over time.

- Expenses by category: Shows a donut chart with the total spent in each category during the selected period.

- Budgets: If you have categories with an assigned budget, you will see a bar indicating how much you have spent compared to that budget.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: The module where you record and manage all your financial movements, whether they are one-off or automated operations.

topics.title: Record Transaction
topics.content:
To add a single movement, click on the '+ New Transaction' button. A form will open where you must specify:

- Description: An identifying name or concept (e.g., Weekly shopping at Lidl).
- Type: Allows classifying the operation as an 'Expense' or 'Income'.
- Amount (€): The exact amount of the operation.
- Category: Allows assigning the movement to an existing category through a dropdown menu.

topics.title: New Recurring Transaction
topics.content:
If you have fixed payments or receipts, you can automate them using the 'Recurring' button. This form includes the basic fields of a normal transaction, adding scheduling options:

- Frequency and Interval: Allows configuring how often the operation will repeat.
- Start date: Defines the exact day the system will start recording the movement automatically.
- End date (optional): Establishes a time limit for the transaction to stop repeating.

topics.title: Filtering and Search
topics.content:
The system includes tools to quickly locate your records:

- Quick tabs: Buttons to filter the list showing 'All', only 'Income', or only 'Expenses'. It includes a counter with the total number of operations found.
- Search bar: A text input ('Search by description...') that allows you to find a specific movement by typing the key terms of its concept.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The module designed to classify your financial movements and establish monthly spending limits to keep your budgets under control.

topics.title: Create New Category
topics.content:
To register a new classification, click on the '+ New Category' button. A floating form will appear with the following required fields:

- Name: The identifying term for the category (e.g., Food, Transport, Leisure).
- Color: A visual selector or text field to assign a custom color in hexadecimal format (e.g., #FF5733), making it easier to identify visually in charts.
- Monthly budget (€): The maximum amount of money you plan to spend in this category throughout the month.

topics.title: Management and Visualization Panel
topics.content:
On the main screen of the module, you will see a grid featuring all your active categories. Each card clearly displays:

- The name of the category and its associated distinctive color.
- The assigned monthly budget (or the corresponding indication if it was configured without a budget limit).
- Quick action buttons to manage the item in real time.

topics.title: Modify and Delete
topics.content:
Each category card features two direct action icons in the upper right corner:

- Edit Icon (Pencil): Reopens the form to modify the name, change the color palette, or adjust the monthly budget limit.
- Delete Icon (Trash bin): Allows you to remove the category from the system safely.

investments.title: Investments
investments.description: The module designed for tracking your variable financial assets, allowing you to control the evolution of your portfolio's value and its profitability in real time.

topics.title: Portfolio Metrics and Charts
topics.content:
At the top of the panel, three analytical cards summarize the global status of your portfolio:

- Invested Capital: The total sum of money you have allocated to purchasing your assets.
- Current Value: The current market value of all your combined holdings.
- Return / Profit: The accumulated net profit or loss (featuring a percentage and trend indicator in green or red).

Right below, you have advanced visual panels, including a line chart tracking the value of your wealth over time and a chart detailing the distribution of your funds based on asset type.

topics.title: Register New Investment
topics.content:
To add a new asset to your portfolio, click on the '+ New Investment' button. A floating form will open with the following required fields:

- Name and Ticker: The name of the asset (e.g., Apple) and its short trading code (e.g., AAPL).
- Quantity: The total number of units or shares acquired.
- Purchase price (€): The unit cost you paid when acquiring the asset.
- Current price (€): The current market trading unit value.
- Investment type: Dropdown menu to classify the nature of the asset.

topics.title: Price Updates and Operations
topics.content:
The bottom grid or list displays all active investments. Each item features quick action buttons to keep your data up to date:

- Update Current Price: An exclusive shortcut that allows you to quickly modify the market price of an asset individually to immediately recalculate gains without editing the entire entry.
- Edit Investment: Allows correcting any of the original parameters of the record.
- Remove (Trash bin): Performs a logical deletion to safely remove the asset from your active portfolio view.

family.title: Group Goals
family.description: The cooperative module that allows you to manage a shared budget, invite other users, and monitor each member's contributions toward a common goal.

topics.title: Progress and Group Goal Settings
topics.content:
At the top, you will see your 'Monthly Target' and a 'Progress this month' bar that graphically reflects the percentage and total amount gathered. You can modify the group rules from the gear icon (Group Goal settings), where you will define:

- Group Goal Name: Group identifier.
- Monthly Target (€): The total financial amount the group aims to collect during the month.
- Distribution Mode: Allows choosing how the target payment is split among users via three options: 'Equal parts', 'Proportional to salary', or 'Custom percentages'.

topics.title: Member Management and Invitations
topics.content:
The central panel 'Group Goal Members' outlines the participants, their role (ADMIN or MEMBER), their distribution setup (salary/percentage), their assigned 'Share' (what they must pay), and what they have already 'Contributed'.

- + Invite Member: Opens a dialog box to add someone new by entering the 'Email of the user to invite'.
- Individual actions: At the end of each member's row, there is an options menu (three dots) that allows you to 'Edit member' (to adjust their financial parameters) or 'Remove member' to dismiss them from the group.

topics.title: Recording and Tracking Contributions
topics.content:
The bottom table 'Recent Contributions' tracks the historical log of capital injections into the common fund:

- + Add Button: Opens the 'Record Contribution' form where you must indicate the 'Amount to contribute (€)'. This will automatically update the main progress bar.
- History: Displays the member's name, the contributed amount, and the operation date. It features a trash icon under the 'Actions' column to delete contributions recorded by mistake.
